##Gene Sets
```{r}
sasp <- c(
  "CCL11", "CCL13", "CCL14", "CCL15", "CCL16", "CCL19", "CCL2", "CCL20", 
  "CCL21", "CCL26", "CCL28", "CCL3", "CCL3L1", "CCL4", "CCL5", "CCL7", 
  "CCL8", "CXCL1", "CXCL10", "CXCL11", "CXCL12", "CXCL13", "CXCL14", 
  "CXCL16", "CXCL2", "CXCL3", "CXCL5", "CXCL6", "CXCL9", "IL12B", 
  "IL13", "IL15", "IL18", "IL1A", "IL1B", "IL2", "IL23A", "IL4", "IL5", 
  "IL6", "MMP12", "MMP9", "MMP3", "VEGFA", "TNF", "TGFB1", "CSF1", "EGF", 
  "FGF2", "IFNB1", "CMKLR1"
)

```


```{r}

mmp <- grep("^MMP", rownames(hsskin.ST), value= TRUE)

DefaultAssay(hsskin.ST) <- 'SCT'
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- 'age'
VlnPlot(object = hsskin.ST, features = mmp, split.by = 'age', layer="data")

DotPlot(
    object = hsskin.ST, 
    features = c("MMP3", "MMP12", "MMP9"),
    cols = c("blue", "red"), # Set color scale
    dot.scale = 8 # Adjust dot size
) + 
  RotatedAxis()

mmp_list <- list(MMP_Module = c("MMP3", "MMP12", "MMP9"))

# Calculate the score
hsskin.ST <- AddModuleScore(
  object = hsskin.ST,
  features = mmp_list,
  name = "MMP_Score", # This will create a column named 'MMP_Score1'
  ctrl = 10 #needed because there aren't enough genes in the same expresison bin
)

# Visualize the combined score by Age
VlnPlot(hsskin.ST, features = "MMP_Score1", group.by = "age")
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- 'age'
ImageFeaturePlot(hsskin.ST, features = "MMP_Score1", fov = "fov.5")
ImageFeaturePlot(hsskin.ST, features = "MMP_Score1", fov = "fov.2")


Idents(hsskin.ST) <- 'age_celltype'

hsskin.ST$age_celltype <- paste(hsskin.ST$age, hsskin.ST$cell_type_major, sep = "_")

DotPlot(
    object = hsskin.ST, 
    group.by = "cell_type_major",
    split.by = "age",
    features = c("MMP3", "MMP12", "MMP9"),
    cols = c("blue", "red"), # Set color scale
    dot.scale = 8 # Adjust dot size
) + 
  RotatedAxis()

p <- ImageDimPlot(hsskin.ST, fov = "fov.5", cols = c("red","#31476e", "#add8e6"), axes = FALSE, dark.background = FALSE,   size = 1.5, crop= TRUE)

```

## SnC Calculation in Xenium

```{r}

gene_list <- c(
  "CCL11", "CCL13", "CCL14", "CCL15", "CCL16", "CCL19", "CCL2", "CCL20", 
  "CCL21", "CCL26", "CCL28", "CCL3", "CCL3L1", "CCL4", "CCL5", "CCL7", 
  "CCL8", "CXCL1", "CXCL10", "CXCL11", "CXCL12", "CXCL13", "CXCL14", 
  "CXCL16", "CXCL2", "CXCL3", "CXCL5", "CXCL6", "CXCL9", "IL12B", 
  "IL13", "IL15", "IL18", "IL1A", "IL1B", "IL2", "IL23A", "IL4", "IL5", 
  "IL6", "MMP12", "MMP9", "MMP3", "VEGFA", "TNF", "TGFB1", "CSF1", "EGF", 
  "FGF2", "IFNB1", "CMKLR1"
)

sasp_counts <- hsskin.ST@assays$Xenium$counts[sasp, ]
sasp_positive <- colSums(sasp_counts) > 0
  # CD45 & (CDKN1A | CDKN2A) &(!PCNA) & (IL6|IL8|hILa|IP10|CXCR3) ~ "SnC+ CD45+",
  # CD45 ~ "CD45+",

p21 <- hsskin.ST@assays$Xenium$counts["CDKN1A",] > 0.0
p16 <- hsskin.ST@assays$Xenium$counts["CDKN2A",] > 0.0

PCNA <- hsskin.ST@assays$Xenium$counts["PCNA",] > 0.0
Ki67 <- hsskin.ST@assays$Xenium$counts["MKI67",] > 0.0

CD45 <- hsskin.ST@assays$Xenium$counts["PTPRC",] > 0.0 # PTPRC is equivalent to CD45

hsskin.ST@meta.data$snc <- case_when(
  (p21 | p16) &(!PCNA | !Ki67) & sasp_positive ~ "SnC+",
  CD45 ~ "CD45+",
  TRUE ~ 'none'
)



hsskin.ST$snc <- factor(hsskin.ST$snc, levels = c("SnC+", "CD45+", "none" ))


# the order of fov? "1738-Y" "1883-Y" "4890-O" "4891-O" "5138-O" "7503-Y"

Idents(hsskin.ST) <- 'snc'
p <- ImageDimPlot(hsskin.ST, fov = "fov.5", cols = c("red","#31476e", "#add8e6"), axes = FALSE, dark.background = FALSE,   size = 1.5, crop= TRUE)
ggsave("5138_snc.png", plot = p, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 500)

hsskin.ST@meta.data$cd45snc <- case_when(
  (p21 | p16) &(!PCNA | !Ki67) & sasp_positive & CD45 ~ "CD45+ SnC",
  TRUE ~ 'none'
)

immsen3 <- as.data.frame(table(hsskin.ST$age, hsskin.ST$cd45snc))

cells <- as.data.frame(immsen3 %>%
                         group_by(Var1) %>%
                         mutate(Freq = Freq / sum(Freq)))
#cells <- cells[cells$Var2 == 'SnC+ CD45+',]
cells <- cells[cells$Var2 != 'none',]


cells <- cells %>%
  group_by(Var1) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Freq * 100, 1))  # Convert proportion to percentage

library(ggplot2)



#ff0000


### THE BLACK BORDER & NUMBERS
# Create stacked bar plot with black borders and percentage labels
stacked_barplot <- ggplot(cells, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +  # Black borders
  scale_fill_manual(values = "#ff0000") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4, color = "black") +  # Percentage labels inside bars
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of CD45+ Sncs in Young vs. Old",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Cell Types"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    # Explicitly remove gridlines and background elements if using theme_minimal
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

# Display the plot
print(stacked_barplot)
ggsave("combined_sncimm.png", plot = stacked_barplot, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```
